title: Java Collections & Algorithms
intro: Java Collections interview questions test how well you understand the framework you reach for every day — ArrayList vs LinkedList, HashMap internals, the contract between equals() and hashCode(), iteration safety, and which Set/Queue to pick under contention. This page covers the framework alongside the algorithm questions interviewers pair with it (Big-O for common operations, sorting, searching, sliding window, two pointers, tree and graph traversal, basic DP). For thread-safe collections (ConcurrentHashMap, CopyOnWriteArrayList) and the concurrency primitives behind them, see the Java Concurrency page. Each answer leads with the structural insight ("a HashMap is an array of buckets...") then drops into the implementation details senior interviewers actually probe.
